topic: E-signature for employment contracts — three signatures across two countries, end-to-end in one platform
format: Open with the specific operational problem, then show how one SmartPRO Hub feature addresses it end-to-end
post:
A hiring manager in Dubai sends a contract. The candidate is in Muscat. The department head is in Riyadh.

Three signatures. Two countries. One deadline.

Most teams handle this with a PDF chain — email, download, print, scan, re-upload, follow up on WhatsApp. By the time all three signatures land, the candidate has already accepted another offer.

SmartPRO Hub's e-signature module was built for exactly this situation.

Send one contract from the platform. Each signatory gets a secure link — no app to download, no account to create. You can see who opened it, who signed, and who's still sitting on it. Everything is fully bilingual, Arabic and English.

No chasing people down. No "which version did you sign?" No contracts buried across three different inboxes.

Our customers across Oman and the GCC use this for employment contracts, offer letters, and service agreements. Everything tracked, stored, and auditable in one place.

If your process still relies on PDF attachments and hoping everyone checks their email in time, that's the problem this solves.

How many days does your current contract process take from draft to final signature?
